meta_description: Sandertons Plastering delivers expert plastering across Manchester. Interior & exterior work, skimming, renders. Free quotes, professional finish guaranteed.
hero_subhead: Crack in your plasterwork? We transform walls and ceilings with precision finish. Free quotes, no fuss.
services_heading: Complete Plastering Services Across Greater Manchester
services_subhead: From internal skimming and renders to external renders and specialist finishes, we cover every plastering need.

services.title: Interior Skimming & Finishing
services.desc: Smooth, professional skimming of walls and ceilings — we fix cracks, damp patches, and uneven surfaces. Perfect preparation for decoration.

services.title: External Renders
services.desc: Weather-resistant external renders protect your property and enhance curb appeal. We use quality materials and proven techniques for long-lasting results.

services.title: Plasterboard Installation
services.desc: Expert boarding and taping for extensions, lofts, and renovations. We ensure level surfaces ready for final finishing.

services.title: Artex Removal & Replacement
services.desc: Safe removal of textured Artex finishes and replacement with modern smooth plaster or alternative finishes.

services.title: Damp Repair & Replastering
services.desc: We strip back affected plaster, address the damp source, and replaster using specialist solutions to prevent recurrence.

services.title: Specialist Finishes & Decorative Plaster
services.desc: Polished plaster, venetian finishes, and bespoke decorative work to create striking feature walls and unique interior spaces.

about_pullquote: I built Sandertons on doing the job right — no cutting corners, no hidden costs.
about_para_1: Sandertons Plastering was established 15 years ago in Stretford, Manchester, with a simple goal: deliver pristine plasterwork every time. We've completed over 500 domestic and commercial projects across Greater Manchester, earning a reputation for attention to detail and honest pricing. All our work is carried out by experienced plasterers who take pride in their craft.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we turn up on time, and we leave sites clean and tidy. Whether you need a single ceiling skimmed or a full house replastered, we treat the work with the same care and professionalism. We're not the cheapest — we're the best value.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Homeowners Say About Sandertons

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with damp plaster in our bedroom. Sandertons came round, sorted the issue properly and replastered the whole wall to a brilliant finish. They were tidy, professional, and didn't charge a fortune. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Called them for an urgent ceiling repair after a leak upstairs. They came within two days, assessed the problem carefully, and gave me a fair quote. The finish is flawless. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Emma H.

reviews.text: Plastered three bedrooms and a hallway for our renovation. Punctual, hardworking lads, and the quality is exceptional. They cleaned up after themselves too, which is rare. Great service.
reviews.author: Michael B.
